_note: NASA's Global Hawk is a single mesh with the wings fused into the same primitive as the fuselage, so the wing cannot be a separate node. Instead we cut it: keeping only the centre band hides both wings at once, and a replacement wing mounts at the cut.

wing.comment: Measured with scripts/measure-band.py. The span band alone reached 9102 of the 10274 vertices outboard of the fuselage - the V-tail and the engine fairing as well as the wing. The wing tip sits between 0.279 and 0.303 of the model's height, a very flat panel, and everything outboard at that height runs 0.376 to 0.548 fore and aft.
